purpose: Restore exact-head CI after two independently reproduced external upstream drifts: MinIO public registry authorization failures and hosted CodeQL advancing to 2.27.1.
requiredInvariants: Production-like MinIO server and mc use the same historical release versions as before; no application/runtime compatibility version changes are introduced.
Server and mc binaries are downloaded only from first-party GitHub release assets and fail closed unless their pinned SHA-256 values match.

The local image base is the pinned Docker Official Image alpine:3.20.3 OCI index digest; the resulting server and mc images are pushed into the existing ephemeral kind registry and referenced by the registry-returned sha256 digest.
Only the three existing MinIO image references are rewritten at kubectl invocation time; tracked source manifests remain unchanged and the rewrite fails closed if source references drift.
No Kubernetes timeout, probe, resource, security-context, network, DB, application or acceptance threshold changes.
CodeQL query, barrier, workflow, fixture corpus, selection rule and security thresholds remain unchanged.
CodeQL upstream query, flow configuration and customizations retain the previously reviewed blob SHAs while only CLI and bundled pack provenance advances to 2.27.1 / 2.4.6 / 2.10.2.
The existing provenance unit assertions advance only to the same pinned versions as the lock.
Exact-head Production-like Kubernetes and full CodeQL compile/regression/selection/drift/SARIF must both pass before merge.
